proof: The nth line has at most n-1 distinct crossings with old lines. These create at most n connected sections inside the disk, each splitting one old convex region. General position with intersections inside attains this, giving Rn=Rn-1+n. Hence R3=7,R4=11,R5=16. Concurrent crossings merge and reduce the increase.
limits: Numerical checks supplement the stated general proof. No audience learning is inferred.
